title: Darklands+ art checklist
scope: Named replacements and original-format art in the base game. A group describes where its assets come from and how to use them. A pack can cover any subset.

routes.picture: Named PIC when drawn through the replacement-art renderer.
routes.battle: Named picture used by the battlefield renderer.
routes.generated_picture: Optional named portrait generated for an available figure.
routes.optional: Additional named picture supported by Darklands+. Extra crests follow the picker in order.
routes.native: Original-format file or entry within a file.
routes.sheet_region: Cell within an original map sheet.
routes.reference: Colour data used by other pictures.

fields.file: Preferred PNG filename inside the mod's art folder. Only entries with this field count towards PNG coverage.
fields.native_px: Original canvas [width, height] in game pixels. High-resolution artwork can use any size. For the display aspect, scale width by 5 and height by 6.
fields.ink_box: Visible native sprite bounds [left, top, right, bottom], with right and bottom exclusive. Null means the original is entirely transparent.
fields.slots: On a fighter asset, every animation slot sharing the named drawing. Pose = slot // 8, facing index = slot % 8. Keep the feet aligned across poses.
fields.town_types: Town battlefield definitions that can select this scenery. town_layouts lists the maps for each type.
fields.source_rect: Region within a native sheet [left, top, width, height].

templates: Export personal-use templates in F12 > Mods. Look in art/original for the matching filename. Battle templates depend on which pictures have been drawn. The JSON contains metadata only.

open_ended.lookup: Show the picture name in F12 > Mods.
Use the picture name chosen by the mod.
